notes.title: Fluffy Kitchen Saga Playtest is now open!
notes.content: [p][/p][h2]Fluffy Kitchen Saga Playtest is now open! The little critters are waiting for you to open your shop~ ✨ [/h2][p]  QWQ Dear shop owners, hello everyone! 🌟 After countless days and nights of meticulous preparation (and under the “supervision and guidance” of our studio's real furry friends), Fluffy Kitchen Saga is finally ready to meet you all! We're now officially launching our free Playtest, inviting everyone to experience this warm and healing fluffy world!  Translated with [/p][p][url="https://DeepL.com"]DeepL.com[/url][/p][p] (free version)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621143/efb34821aa034f0986b300e9a1fefe6eca56be1f.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]🌟 A Warm Message from the Developers[/h2][p]As a development team, we deeply understand the busyness and pressures of modern life. Through countless late nights working overtime and intense study sessions, we all crave some warm companionship.[/p][p]This is the heartfelt inspiration behind Fluffy Kitchen Saga—we wanted to create a cozy corner that’s always waiting for you, filled with furry friends who are forever kind to you.[/p][p]Throughout development, we meticulously observed each animal's habits and endearing traits, carefully designing every movement and expression. We hope you'll feel that pure joy when you see a kitten lick its lips contentedly or hear a puppy's happy bark.[/p][p][/p][h2]🎁 How to Join the Playtest?[/h2][p]1. Apply for access now - Click “Request Access” on the game page[/p][p]2. Add to Wishlist - Never miss updates about the official release[/p][p]3. Join our community - Share management tips and adorable moments with fellow shop owners[/p][p][/p][h2]🍀 Friendly Reminders[/h2][p]- Suitable for all ages, especially recommended for those seeking companionship and healing. Each player can invite one friend to join the test![/p][p]- Best enjoyed during work or study breaks—let the fluffy friends accompany your daily routine[/p][p][/p][h2]💌 A Message from Us[/h2][p]In this fast-paced world, we all need warmth and healing.Fluffy Kitchen Saga isn't just a game—it's a little gift we want to give to every weary soul.[/p][p]When you're busy, we hope you'll glance down at your screen and see those fluffy little creatures savoring their meals, quietly keeping you company. May this simple warmth add a touch of brightness to your life.[/p]
